'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Kupiansk offensive]]
***[[Russia|Russian]] [[Chief of the General Staff (Russia)|Chief of the General Staff]] [[Valery Gerasimov]] announces that [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] have captured the city of [[Kupiansk]], the administrative centre of [[Kupiansk Raion]], [[Kharkiv Oblast]]. The [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]] denies the statement. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-met-with-russian-top-military-brass-kremlin-says-2025-11-20/ (Reuters)]
**[[Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war]], [[United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[United States]] outlines a new 28-point [[peace treaty|peace proposal]] to end the war in [[Ukraine]], including a ''[[casus foederis]]'' guarantee for Ukraine and the cession of [[Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine]] to [[Russia]]. [https://www.axios.com/2025/11/20/trump-ukraine-peace-plan-28-points-russia (Axios)]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] gives Ukraine a deadline of November 27 to accept the peace proposal, or the U.S. will end all weapons shipments and [[military intelligence]] support. [[President of Russia|Russian president]]  [[Vladimir Putin]] confirms he has formally received the proposal from the U.S. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c6257wrx301t (BBC News)]
**[[Zaporizhzhia strikes (2022–present)|Zaporizhzhia strikes]]
***Five people are killed and three others are injured in a Russian [[glide bomb]] strike on a high-rise apartment block in [[Zaporizhzhia]], Ukraine. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/11/21/at-least-five-killed-in-russian-glide-bomb-strike-on-southern-ukraine (Euronews)]

***One person is shot, and 315 people, including 12 teachers and 303 schoolchildren, are abducted in an attack on a [[Catholic school]] in [[Agwara]], [[Niger State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3w7621xypyo (BBC News)]
